item.name: token
Create Access Token with User Auth Credentials

exec: pm.expect.fail("Error! Please select and Environment to set the access_token value.");
console.log("✅ Token successfully saved in the {{access_token}} variable");

request.description:
This endpoint will create an OAuth 2.0 Access Token needed to authenticate in our API. This method requires a set of Client ID + Client Secret and a set of Username + Password.

The scope of the `access_token` received is the same as the user whose credentials are used (role, permissions).

This request contains a Script to save the received `access_token` in the `{{access_token}}` variable in the selected Environment.

Please consider the expiration time of the token, expressed in seconds in the `expires_in` variable in the response (8 hours by default)

item.name: Create Access Token with Client Auth Credentials

exec: pm.expect.fail("Error! Please select and Environment to set the access_token value.");
console.log("✅ Token successfully saved in the {{access_token}} variable");

request.description:
This endpoint will create an OAuth 2.0 Access Token needed to authenticate in our API. This method requires a set of Client ID + Client Secret and a set of Username + Password.

The scope of the `access_token` received **is limited only to** the `users` and `roles` services.

This request contains a Script to save the received `access_token` in the `{{access_token}}` variable in the selected Environment.

Please consider the expiration time of the token, expressed in seconds in the `expires_in` variable in the response (8 hours by default)

item.description:
There are 3 options (grant_types) to generate an access token:

- **User Credentials:** validates user credentials. The received token has the scope of the authenticated user (role, permissions, feature access).
    
- **Client Credentials:** validates a pair of client credentials. The received token has scope only for the Users service (create, edit users)

item.name: roles

query.description: Comma separated value of the relationships to include

request.description:
The response contains an array with all availabe roles for the Platform's users. By default, there are only 2 roles: `admin` and `basic`.

The corresponding IDs for each role are required for the `users` endpoints in case an specific role is intended.

Role IDs are unique and unchangeble for each Platform.

item.name: List Holder Budgets for a Program

request.description:
List available holder-program-budgets and their available balances.

This endpoint's returns required information to send a points recognition:

- The `reco-holder-program-budgets` ID: This ID represents the access of the current user to a budget for sending points in the filtered `rewards_program_id`. This ID is the `rewards_holder_program_budget_id` required to send points in that Rewards program.
    
- The `reco-holder-program-budgets` Balance: It is the budget available balance in points. Check available balance before sending points.
    
- The `reco-holder-program-budgets` Holder: Current user's user_id. This ID is the `rewards_sender_user_id` required to send points in a Rewards program.
    
- The `gbnk-fantasy-currencies` ID: It is the Budget's Fantasy currency ID.
